ARCHITECTURE.md — 1.4.0 draft by P3 (Horde generator and tools-side simulator); the release folds it into the .md
=================================================================================================================
(revised in P3 fix round 1: boss at x 0, D30 crates literal with off-centre drops, patterns never repeat, boss HP signature,
validateHoldSection validates the run part, firstMeet / assist read from the spec; fix round 2: L4 ns 1,820, no centre
opener after the debut, live hpExpAbove 0.25, drops at 2.0-3.0 m, the debut without brutes / spitters, the debut-flag check)

§1 FILE MANIFEST (replace P0's js/holdgen.js row; add the tools row)

| `js/holdgen.js` | P3 | Pure Horde generator (no THREE, no DOM; imports only `util.js` and `data.js`), imported ONLY by `levelgen.js`. `holdSpec(L, seed, opts)` → `{ run, hold, eTarget }`; `generateHoldScript(runScript, spec)` → a new script with `{ type: 'hold', at, spec: spec.hold }` appended (a 'boss' event in the run is dropped: the hold's boss replaces it; `at` = that boss's `at`, else the run's length). Deterministic: one mulberry32 stream seeded (seed·7919 + L). | 1.4.0 |
| `tools/holdsim.js` | P3 | Node-only HORDE hold simulator (never shipped, never reached from js/): `simulateHold`, `buildSpawns`, `holdOf`, `runPhaseLines`, `runPartOf`, `validateHoldSection` (D37), `RULES`, `BOTS`, `C_RATIO`. The port of horde-v2's holdsim2 onto the game's data (holdgen's spec, data.expectedRanksOf, util hold math). | 1.4.0 |

§6.x js/holdgen.js (new section)

holdSpec(L, seed, opts) — opts { debut, boss, variant } all optional; debut defaults to L === HORDE_GEN.debut.level (level.js
passes the LEVEL_TYPES.horde.debut verdict; the two must be equal — validateHoldSection errors when a script's debut flag
differs from L === HORDE_GEN.debut.level). Below L4 (reachable only through ?type=horde&debug=1) the pattern bag is L4's.
- run (the generateRunSteps options, D39): { gates (HORDE_GEN.run.gates: 4 at L4, 5 on L9-22, 6 from L23), eEnd = ref = E_hold,
  noDiv / noTwoRed / noLesser (the debut run phase), crate 'item.kit' (the guaranteed kit crate), kitsLane 'item.kit2' and
  kitsLaneFrom 13 (the purple KITS ×2 lane), fixed { lim 0.80, win 0.84, shops ['expected', 'max'], from 4, repairFrom 4 } }.
- hold (stored in the script's hold event; everything that does not depend on how the level is played):
  L, seed, eBoss, eHold = round5(0.75·eBossOf(L)), debut, variant;
  pExp (fire × damage of data.expectedRanksOf(L)), profileExp (LEAK_MODEL.profileExpByLevel at L), surplusExp, design
  (= E_hold·FIRE.rateBase·pExp·FIRE.accuracy), hz (the unit HP scale at C = E_hold and the expected shop:
  rho(L)·design·spawnEnd / Σ N·baseHp);
  surges [{ t, pattern, n, window, double, lag }], trickle (count), spawnEnd (last surge start + 5.5 s), mix [walker, runner,
  crawler], brutes, spitters (both 0 on the debut, whatever the level), spitKills, climbK;
  boss { id (data.bossIdOf), factor (HORDE_GEN.boss.factor × the archetype's BOSSES hpMult — the plan's hold HP factor),
  bdExp (the expected shop's bossDamage multiplier), split (Twins: hpSplit, else 1), at (last surge start + 2 s), enrageS (30
  on the debut, null = HORDE's 20 s), attacks (false on the debut) }. A single boss spawns at x 0, the Twins at ±2.2 m
  (plan 9.1); the spec carries no x;
  supply [{ t (s), x (m) }] — drop times at 35 % / 70 % of the spawn time; x = ±(2.0…3.0) m, the side and offset from the
  spec stream: a drop never lands in or touching a lane parked at the centre (lane half-width 1.25 m + the 0.4 m crate
  half-size = 1.65 m), so opening one always takes a lane move (D30). The model opens a crate when its centre is within
  1.25 m of the lane centre for 1.0 s; any test up to footprint overlap keeps a centre-parked lane off every drop; airstrike (L ≥ 32), coinPerKill, firstMeet { threat, surge1NeedsDecisions, laterNeedsAction }, assist
  { kitsPerStep, capPerStep } — hold.js reads firstMeet / assist HERE (the single source is HORDE_GEN through the spec; HORDE
  carries no copy).
- Patterns (plan 5.2): never the same pattern twice in a row. Surge 1 from HORDE_GEN.patterns.opener (a flank, the pincer or
  the runner rush: after the debut never the centre, which a lane parked at the centre holds by itself), surge 2 from second
  (always a flank or the pincer), later surges from the level's bag; the debut is centre, then a flank, then a bag pattern
  that differs from the flank. A stampede / siege variant makes its LAST surge its runner rush / brute push (never surge 2,
  which stays a flank or pincer), unless the surge before it already was one.
- eTarget = E_hold.
Live quantities are applied by hold.js at the dig-in with the util hold math (below); the generator never sees the squad.

§6.1 util.js — 'Hold math' section (new; pure, shared by hold.js, holdgen.js and tools/holdsim.js)
- holdHpScale(hz, p, pExp, exp, surplusExp) = hz·shopComp(p, pExp, exp, surplusExp) / pExp^exp — the live shop's unit HP scale
  (horde-v2's (p / pExp)^exp at or below the expected shop; the whole surplus above it, D26).
- holdLiveScale(r, HORDE_GEN.live), r = C / E_hold at the dig-in: the surge COUNTS × min(cap 2, r^expAbove) for r ≥ 1, × 1 below.
- holdLiveHp(r, HORDE_GEN.live): the unit HP × max(floor 0.4, r)^exp for r < 1 (A9: the relief horde-v2 took off the counts;
  what is on screen never shrinks), × r^hpExpAbove for r ≥ 1 (A4 key, 0.25: with the counts' r^0.75 the crowd's HP grows as
  r^1.0 above E_hold, so a bigger squad meets a proportionally bigger crowd).
- holdBossHp(eBoss, factor, r, p, bd, bdExp, HORDE_GEN.boss) = round(0.38·24·eBoss·factor·clamp(r^ratioExp, 0.6, 2)·
  clamp(p^(0.9·min(1, r)), 1, 10)·bdExp^0.1·bd^0.9). ratioExp is 0.6 below E_hold and ratioExpAbove (A4 key, 1.0) above it;
  p = (fireRate / rateBase)·damage of the live shop (horde-v2's m), bd = its bossDamage, bdExp = spec.boss.bdExp. The squad's
  boss damage carries bd (plan 9.1 hit rule: profile.bossDamage); the bdExp^0.1·bd^0.9 term keeps an expected shop on
  horde-v2's tuned boss TTK (horde-v2 had no boss-damage rank on either side) and nets a surplus (bd / bdExp)^0.1, as the
  run's shop scale. Twins: each takes boss.split.
- holdClimbK(eHold, HORDE_GEN.climb) = clamp(330 / E_hold, 1, 2).
- holdFocusRate(f, 0.5) = 0.5 + 0.5·f for focus level f ∈ [0, 1] (dwell / 0.8 s).
hold.js (P6) at the dig-in: hzShop = holdHpScale(hz, p, pExp, profileExp, surplusExp); countMult = holdLiveScale(r);
hpLive = holdLiveHp(r). Unit HP = max(1, baseHp[type]·hzShop) × hpLive × (its surge eased ? spec.firstMeet.threat : 1):
the floor applies to the shop-scaled HP only, so the A9 relief and the ease still act where it binds (L4); boss minions take
max(1, baseHp·hzShop). An eased surge's units and the trickle that follows it spawn weaker, never fewer (D29 per surge, A9).
The debut hold spawns no boss-phase brutes (the Hulk's 25 % brutes are dropped; its runners and walkers stay).

§6.x tools/holdsim.js (new section)
- simulateHold(scriptOrHold, bot, seed, opts): one hold at 30 Hz, deterministic per arguments. opts: cRatio | C, cVar, ranks,
  firstMeet + runDecisions (D29), easeAll (every surge eased: the threat-0.85-on-every-surge bound), kitsExtra (D35 assist
  steps), runKits, stored, sep, boss, bossHpMult, runS, trace; experiments: live / threat / bossRules overrides, relief and
  ease ({ hp, win } exponents: where the below-E_hold factor and the threat act — unit HP and / or the surge spawn windows),
  countEase (horde-v2's count relief, comparisons only), crateMoved (the pre-fix D30 reading), supplyX (horde-v2's drop x),
  bossX, bossHpRun (the plan formula with m = the run's p·bd and no bdExp term). Returns won, stars, reason, C0 → C, hold /
  level seconds, kills, peak alive, surge peaks within 40 m, wall / boss statistics, holdActions, holdSurgeWindows,
  windupWindows, eased [3], easedBy [3] ('' | 'lane' | 'repair' | 'crate'), actionsBy { lane, repair, crate },
  assistEligible, eligibleWithoutCrates.
- Bots: passive, oscillator, aimer, aimerR (decent), human (skilled), strong (expert), swipeOnce (one 6.8 m drag at the
  dig-in, then the lane rests at centre), swipePerSurge (a 2.5 m drag 2 s before each surge spawn), steerRunIdleHold (a
  steered run's arrival and run decisions, then a passive hold).
- Hold actions (D30, literal): a 3 s ring of lane-target travel sampled per tick; a window at each surge spawn and each boss
  wind-up start counts one action when the target travelled ≥ 2 m, a repair was made or a supply crate was opened in the 3 s
  before it. Every opened crate counts; drops land off the centre lane (holdgen), so a hands-off hold never opens one.
- buildSpawns(hold, countMult, rand, surgeMult, winMult): the unit timetable [{ t, type, x, tx, s, p0, tr }] (s = the surge
  whose ease the unit follows, p0 = its surge part's start, tr = 1 for trickle units). hold.js ports it with ctx.rng
  (patterns: flank 80 % to the end section, sweeps by spawn phase, split alternating, brute push / crawler carpet / spitter
  battery on one section per surge, double surges on the opposite flank after the lag).
- runPhaseLines(L, script, ref): the run phase's fixed lines (levelgen.fixedLines) at the expected shop and at rank 10 with the
  D26 wave compensation (DPS × p / shopComp(p, …, LEAK_MODEL.surplusExp), as levelgen's fixedCheck), as fractions of ref,
  plus the greedy design line at the stop.
- runPartOf(script): the run phase of a Horde script as levelgen generated it — its events with the run's boss (levelgen.
  runCurve's bossId / bossHp, in the generator's shape) back at the stop, for levelgen.validateLevel: it deep-equals the
  run script the generator returned (36/36 scripts checked), so the validator sees exactly the generated run phase.
- validateHoldSection(script, { runs 3, runErrors }): the D37 report — E_hold, N, rho, the HP table, peak alive vs 2,048 + 256,
  the fixed lines at both shops, the run phase's validator errors (validateLevel(runPartOf(script)) unless the caller passes
  runErrors), passive (threat 1.0, the script's own seed, at max(0.7, the expected line)), aimerR and human over `runs` seeds
  (a count: the report never depends on machine speed). ERRORS: expected line > 0.90·E_hold, passive clears, the run phase
  invalid (any validator error — its E-trace outside the generator's ±traceTolerance band, a shape error, or an unknown item
  until P1T adds 'item.kit' / 'item.kit2'), rank-10 line > 1.25·E_hold, peak alive > 2,304. WARNINGS: expected line > 0.82,
  rank-10 line > 0.95, aimerR or human fails. Also an ERROR: the spec's debut flag ≠ (L === HORDE_GEN.debut.level). Cost
  about 4-5.5 s per level in node (runs 3; the verifier's figure on a loaded machine) — P1T times validate-levels --type horde.
- RULES: the runtime rule values the model assumes (PLAN horde 'Fixed values'); they must equal HORDE (P6). Not modelled: the
  runtime's 0.5 s of clear gap before a breached section rebuilds (the model rebuilds once no unit is in the gap), so in-engine
  rebuilds come slightly later than in the model.
- Port parity: with countEase (pre-A9 counts), bossDamage rank 0 and horde-v2's crate x, the port reproduced plan r2's
  holdsim2-r2 exactly before the fix round (108/108 holds; the verifier's extension 216/216 on all 12 levels).

§9 DATA REGIONS — HORDE_GEN (P3)
eHoldShare 0.75; rho lerp [[4, 0.505], [30, 0.73], [60, 0.865], [120, 0.955]]; surplusExp 1.0; baseHp walker 2 / runner 1.5 /
crawler 1.5 / brute 24 / spitter 8; surges { count 3, firstAt 2, gap 20, jitter 3, antiRhythm 1.2, window [3.0, 5.5], shares
[1.20, 1.25, 1.30], trickle 0.12, ns lerp [[4, 1820], [5, 2250], [30, 2400], [60, 2700]] (L4: horde-v2's 2,000 × 0.651 /
0.717 — at the 1.4.0 L4 expected shop every fodder unit is on the 1-HP floor), double { from 19, chance 0.4,
lateFrom 35, lateChance 0.6, split 0.55, lag [4.0, 6.5] } }; patterns { bag (step), opener [flankL, flankR, pincer, runnerRush], second [flankL, flankR, pincer], flank 0.8 }; variants
{ from 20, list, stampedeRunners 0.12, siege 1.5, swarm 1.25 }; mix (step); counts { brutes, spitters, spitKills }; live { exp
0.75, expAbove 0.75 (A4 key), hpExpAbove 0.25 (A4 key), floor 0.4, cap 2 }; firstMeet { threat 0.85, surge1NeedsDecisions 3,
laterNeedsAction true }; assist { kitsPerStep 1, capPerStep 1, maxSteps 4 }; climb { ref 330, lo 1, hi 2 }; supply { at [0.35,
0.70], x [2.0, 3.0], count (step), airstrikeFrom 32, airstrikeKits 3 }; boss { hpFrac 0.38, hpPerE 24, spawnAfter 2, factor,
ratioExp 0.6, ratioExpAbove 1.0 (A4 key at its top), ratioMin 0.6, ratioMax 2, mExp 0.9, mMax 10 }; debut { level 4,
enrageS 30 }; coins { scale, lateRef, n1, lineHeldPerL 10, kitRefund 10 }; run { gates (step), fixed, debut, crate, kitsLane,
kitsLaneFrom }.
